call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one finished flat online recruitment poster, portrait 2:3.
Primary request: A Korean poster recruiting participants for a coast cleanup. Generate only one independent poster with the complete exact copy below. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Visual argument: “함께 줍는” is a visible cooperative act. Show two volunteers cooperating on the same pickup: one crouches on the sandy beach and closes the jaws of an ordinary litter tong around a small discarded plastic scrap; the other steadies an open collection bag beside that pickup so the scrap can be deposited. The tongs, scrap, hands, bag opening and beach surface must connect plausibly. A restrained band of sea, small waves and shoreline keeps the coast identifiable. This is a believable collection action, not people posing in a pristine landscape. The depicted number is illustrative, not an attendance claim.

Style and surfaces: precise contemporary editorial illustration, flat opaque shapes with finely controlled brush edges, uncoated cream background, ocean-blue water and typography, sand tones, and a restrained orange accent on the collection bag and registration area. Human skin, cloth, plastic and sand have distinct matte surfaces; no indiscriminate texture or gloss. Clear anatomical hands, functional tong joints and gripping jaws, bag rim visibly held open. Daylight, consistent soft contact shadows, grounded feet and objects.

Composition and type relationship: Use a strong portrait composition with an ample left text alignment. The large Korean title is a compact two-line unit at the top, “우리 바다,” followed by “함께 줍는 토요일”; the recruitment line follows at a clearly smaller but substantial size. Under this title, the two volunteers face into one shared collection point and the diagonals of arms and tongs lead into the practical invitation beneath them. Keep the title visually connected to the shared action rather than isolated in a generic empty corner. The action is a broad, legible middle illustration, scaled to leave enough room for every long sentence. The practical text occupies a generous clean cream reading area: group appointment and meeting point together, eligibility with supplied and personal equipment, and weather with cost/certificate conditions. These groups use exact provided wording without new section headings. Use deliberate vertical spacing between groups, short readable line lengths, well matched Korean/Latin baselines, substantial body type, and optically even margins. Wrap only at word boundaries when needed. No tiny footer copy. The longest weather sentence and the personal-preparation sentence must remain easy to read at a 720px wide on-screen view.

Registration: make the complete deadline and full application URL immediately findable in a strong orange horizontal field near the bottom. Use the exact existing registration line, allowing a word-boundary line wrap after the colon if needed, with the URL in clear large Latin sans-serif and no missing characters. The contact line is directly below with comfortable margin. There is no invented button label.

Text rules: Render each of the following twelve supplied items exactly once, verbatim, including word spaces, punctuation, middle dots, dates, numerals, the colon, hyphen and URL slash. Meaning-based regrouping and line wrapping at existing word boundaries are allowed. Do not abbreviate, paraphrase, duplicate or omit any item. The quoted list is the complete artwork copy; its delimiters are not printed:
“우리 바다, 함께 줍는 토요일”
“하람 해변 정화 참여자 모집”
“2026년 11월 21일 토요일”
“오전 9시 30분 집결 · 낮 12시 종료”
“하람시 물결마당 앞 · 파도길 8”
“대상: 만 14세 이상 누구나 · 선착순 40명”
“집게와 수거 봉투는 제공됩니다.”
“개인 장갑, 마실 물, 모자를 준비해 주세요.”
“우천 시 취소되며 신청자에게 전날 문자로 안내합니다.”
“참가비 무료 · 봉사 확인서는 발급하지 않습니다.”
“11월 18일까지 신청: haram-wave.example/join”
“문의: 바다정화 운영팀”

Constraints: All required copy readable with crisp Korean strokes, reliable word spacing and high contrast. A single flat poster filling the canvas edge to edge, exact portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, no border or surrounding mockup. No collage of variants, no extra text, headings, badges, numbering, icons containing text, logos, fake microtext, watermarks, decorative marks, QR codes or invented facts. Avoid melted hands, detached tongs, floating debris, implausible bag contact, stock celebration imagery, overdecorated waves, artificial glow and ornamental texture.

residuals: Tong pinch and the lower gloved hand near jaws are mechanically ambiguous.
Title-to-action integration is primarily conventional hierarchy/proximity/alignment.
Full bag transfer is implied by cooperation rather than completed in the depicted moment.
